Scope and source material: Technical literature on open-world person Re-ID
Analytical approach and main output: Comparison of closed- and open-world settings; review of open-set methods and practical requirements
Practical open-world challenge: Queries without gallery matches; heterogeneous inputs, end-to-end search and efficiency; long-term Re-ID
What the present study adds: Extends the review’s discussion of open-world challenges with keyword prevalence and grouping trends

Scope and source material: Deep Re-ID methods, tasks and benchmarks
Analytical approach and main output: Review of feature representation, metric learning and ranking
Practical open-world challenge: Heterogeneous data, end-to-end search, limited or noisy labels, and queries without a gallery match
What the present study adds: Keyword prevalence complements method and benchmark comparisons, separating thematic prominence from publication growth

Scope and source material: Traditional and deep learning methods; datasets and benchmark results
Analytical approach and main output: Taxonomy of contextual and non-contextual methods; comparison of methods and benchmark performance
Practical open-world challenge: Viewpoint and illumination changes, occlusion, low resolution and detection errors
What the present study adds: Offers evolving groups of co-occurring keywords alongside the classification of methods

Scope and source material: Deep learning methods for image- and video-based person Re-ID
Analytical approach and main output: Taxonomy of four families: deep metric learning, local feature learning, generative adversarial learning and sequence feature learning
Practical open-world challenge: Explicitly links end-to-end person search to open-world applications; also discusses cross-modal data, domain adaptation and retrieval efficiency
What the present study adds: Follows method-related keywords over time, adding evidence on prominence and regrouping to families (keyword communities)

Scope and source material: 2,067 initial publications, January 2019-August 2024; separate selection for the technical review
Analytical approach and main output: Technical review; publication and collaboration statistics; keyword co-occurrence map for the full period
Practical open-world challenge: Domain generalization, scalability and privacy; lifelong adaptation for open-world systems proposed as a research direction
What the present study adds: Builds on aggregate keyword mapping with temporal community comparisons and sensitivity tests

Scope and source material: Records from Web of Science Core Collection, 2015-2024
Analytical approach and main output: Five nonoverlapping two-year periods and five cumulative windows; document-normalized prevalence; Louvain and Leiden community detection; overlap and sensitivity analyses
Practical open-world challenge: Discusses unknown-identity rejection and discovery, gallery maintenance and long-term identity continuity; proposes corresponding evaluations
